reading.zh: 从左到右：sectors 划定方向扇区，evidence 记录方向证据，store 存下记忆，progress 累加进度积分；箭头是证据汇入存储并更新进度的流向。
reading.en: Left to right: sectors define direction sectors, evidence records direction evidence, store persists it and progress accumulates the score; arrows show evidence flowing into storage and updating progress.
